 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Saurabh Banerjee
 Order

This is a petition filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking quashing of the FIR No.46/2016 dated 22.01.2016 registered under Section 498A/406/34 IPC at PS Dwarka South, Delhi and all proceeding emanating therefrom in view of the Settlement dated 28.03.2017 arrived at between the parties before Delhi Mediation Centre, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi.

2. This petition is accompanied by the Settlement dated 28.03.2017 [Annexure-D] and is also supported by affidavits of all the petitioners and of respondent no.2, alongwith proofs of their respective I.Ds.
3.
Petitioner nos. 1 and 2 and as also respondent no.2 are present in Court and have been identified by the IO.
Their credentials have been verified by this Court.
4. Issue Notice.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 17/10/2023 at 18:11:45 5.
Learned APP for the State accepts notice.
He confirms that he has no objection to the quashing of the FIR.
6. Respondent no.2 confirms that the petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 have been granted divorce by mutual consent vide Decree of Divorce dated 16.11.2017.
She further affirms the Settlement dated 28.03.2017 and submits that she has voluntarily settled all the disputes with the petitioners.

sentences.text: 7. In view of the settlement arrived at between the parties and following the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Jitendra Raghuvanshi & Ors. Vs. Babita Raguvanshi & Anr (2013) 4 SCC 58, Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab & Anr. (2012) 10 SCC 303 and Narinder Singh & Ors. vs. State of Punjab & Anr. (2014) 6 SCC 466, this Court is of the opinion that continuation of the aforesaid FIR will be an exercise in futility.
